about: Plain-word rewordings that sync_tutorials.py applies to the course catalogue (titles, summaries, written steps of tutorials without a film, quick tips): no acronyms on the page. The words replaced stay in the search text. Steps that name a button keep the button's own words (Connect a CMS). A finished film's chapters are never reworded.
